title: Binance Execution Services Launches Upgraded OTC Dashboard & Limited-Time Campaigns
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance announces the launch of an upgraded OTC trading dashboard consolidating Spot RFQ and Execution into one professional environment, purpose-built for institutional and VIP users. Unified Dashboard for Spot RFQ and Execution Spot RFQ and Execution are now accessible from a single-tabbed dashboard. Switching between execution types automatically carries over relevant trade parameters, and a live market chart is embedded directly alongside the order module for real-time price context. Spot RFQ: Request, Review, and Execute Users can raise a quote request, receive live pricing delivered by their assigned Binance OTC trader, and accept or cancel with a clear confirmation step at each stage. Every action is logged and reflected in the OTC service chat in real time. Execution: Real-Time Visibility and Control Execution is natively integrated into the dashboard. Users can submit a bespoke execution request with an optional limit price, monitor fill progress and average execution price in real time, and raise adjustments or queries directly through the platform, without a need to switch channels. Dedicated OTC Trader Support on Every Order A dedicated OTC service group is automatically created between the user and the Binance trading team on the first request, and persists across all future orders. Quote notifications, status updates, and execution confirmations are all delivered within this chat, giving users a consistent line of communication with their assigned Binance OTC trader throughout. Limited-Time Launch Campaigns  Campaign Period:  2026-06-04 12:00 (UTC) to 2026-07-19 11:59 (UTC)  To celebrate the launch of Binance Execution Services, Binance OTC is offering the following limited-time promotions. Please note, all stablecoin-to-stablecoin, fiat-to-stablecoin, and stablecoin-to-fiat trading pairs are excluded from all volume calculations across all three promotions below. The terms and conditions of these promotions are set out below. How to Participate: Step 1: Register for the Campaign During the Promotion Period, visit the  Campaign Page  and click [Register] to confirm participation. Step 2: Access the OTC New Dashboard  Visit the  new OTC dashboard  and start trading. Promotion 1: New OTC User Exclusive The  first 100 Binance users  who access the new OTC dashboard, complete their first OTC trade,  and  maintain a 30-day OTC trading volume of at least $500,000 USD equivalent during the Campaign Period will  receive a 250 USDC token voucher  on a  first-come, first-served  basis . Promotion 2: Top OTC Traders Reward The  top 10 Binance users  with  a minimum $3,000,000 USD 30-day trading volume  during the Campaign Period will share the prize pool as per the table below: Eligible Users’ Rankings Based on the 30-Day Trading Volume Achieved During the Campaign Period Reward per Eligible User (in Token Voucher) 1st Place 5,000 USDC 2nd - 3rd Places 2,000 USDC 4th - 10th Places 1,000 USDC Promotion 3: Referral Bonus The  first 100 Binance users  who successfully refer an eligible user will  each receive a 150 USDC token voucher  on a  first-come, first-served  basis. To qualify, the referred user must: Access the new OTC dashboard; Complete their first OTC trade;  and Achieve a 30-day OTC volume of at least $500,000 USD equivalent. Note:  Referral information must be submitted via this  Binance Survey . Register Now OTC Eligibility and Access Binance OTC & Execution Services are open to all Binance users. The minimum trade size is $200,000 USD equivalent. All users can now access the Binance Execution Services dashboard through the Binance  OTC portal . For onboarding support, contact your  Binance VIP  account manager or the OTC team directly via the platform. Guides and Related Materials: What Is the Binance VIP Program? Benefits, Tiers & How to Join VIP Fees & Transactions Overview   Terms and Conditions of Limited-Time Launch Campaigns: Only  verified  Binance users who receive this communication during the Campaign Period shall be eligible for any rewards. This promotion (this "Campaign") will run for 45 days, from 2026-06-04 to 2026-07-19 ("Campaign Period"). The Campaign consists of three separate promotions. Eligible users may qualify for one or more promotions simultaneously, subject to the conditions set out below. Rewards for Promotions 1, 2, and 3 are  not mutually exclusive . Users may qualify for rewards from all three Promotions, where applicable. Stablecoin-to-stablecoin, fiat-to-stablecoin, and stablecoin-to-fiat trading pairs are  excluded  from the OTC trading volume calculation across all Promotions. For the purposes of this Campaign, "30-day OTC trading volume" refers to cumulative volume within any rolling 30-day window during the Campaign Period, which cannot extend beyond 2026-07-19. Promotion 1: To be eligible for Promotion 1, users must satisfy all of the following conditions during the Campaign Period: Use the new Binance OTC dashboard; Successfully complete their first OTC trade on the new dashboard; and Achieve a 30-day OTC trading volume of at least USD 500,000 equivalent during the Campaign Period. Qualifying users will receive a reward of 250 USDC token voucher. Rewards are limited to the first 100 qualifying users on a first-come, first-served basis. Once all 100 slots are filled, no further rewards will be distributed under Promotion 1. Promotion 2:  To be eligible for Promotion 2, users must achieve a minimum 30-day OTC trading volume of USD 3,000,000 during the Campaign Period. The top 10 qualifying users, ranked by total OTC trading volume accumulated during the Campaign Period, will receive the following rewards. 1st Place: 5,000 USDC Token Voucher 2nd - 3rd Places: 2,000 USDC Token Voucher each 4th - 10th Places: 1,000 USDC Token Voucher each In the event of a tie, the user who first reached the qualifying volume threshold shall be ranked higher. If fewer than 10 users meet the minimum volume requirement, only qualifying positions will be awarded. Promotion 3: To be eligible for Promotion 3, a referring user ("Referrer") must refer a friend ("Referee") via the Binance Survey during the Campaign Period. A referral qualifies as successful only if the Referrer has submitted the  Binance Survey form  and the Referee satisfies all of the following conditions: Uses the new Binance OTC dashboard; Successfully completes their first OTC trade on the new dashboard; and Achieves a 30-day OTC trading volume of at least USD 500,000 during the Campaign Period. Qualifying Referrers will receive 150 USDC per successful referral. Referral rewards are limited to the first 100 successful referrals on a first-come, first-served basis. Once 100 successful referrals have been recorded, no further Promotion 3 rewards will be distributed. Rewards are distributed manually  by 2026-08-07 , after eligibility has been confirmed by Binance. The validity period for voucher rewards is  21 days  from the date of distribution. Eligible users should claim their vouchers before the expiration date.  Learn how to redeem a voucher . Sub-accounts will  not  be considered as individual participants. The OTC trading volume of sub-accounts will be combined with the master account's volume in the final calculation for all promotions. Market Makers (as defined under Binance's applicable Market Maker program terms) are excluded from this Campaign. This Campaign may not be available or may be restricted in certain jurisdictions or regions, or to certain users, depending on legal and regulatory requirements.  Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants showing any signs of fraudulent behavior immediately. Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants who tamper with Binance program code, or interfere with the operation of Binance program code with other software. By participating in this Campaign, users agree to these terms and conditions, and the following additional terms:  (a)  Binance Terms and Conditions for Prize Promotions ; (b)  Binance Terms of Use ; and (c)  Binance Privacy Policy ; all of which are incorporated by reference into these terms and conditions.  Binance reserves its sole right to determine and/or amend or vary these terms and conditions, including but not limited to its eligibility terms and criteria, the selection and number of winners, and the Promotion Period, for any reason, including but not limited to: Changes in applicable regulations or policies; Obligations arising out of law or decisions issued by courts or public authorities; Anti-money laundering or combating financing terrorism rules; Technical issues beyond our control; Necessity to protect users from potential losses; and Necessity to protect Binance from the loss of reputation.
